data.summary_suggestion: Download electronic fiscal document events with filtering
data.description_suggestion: Downloads events associated with electronic fiscal documents (NF-e, CT-e, NFC-e) with support for filtering by document key, involved CNPJs, event type, or date range. Requires JWT authentication and access key. Returns a collection of events matching the specified criteria. Events are retrieved from the fiscal authority systems and may include status updates, rejections, or processing notifications related to the submitted documents.
